content.title: Oil Extends Gains With Market Watching Venezuela, Ukraine-Russia
content.summary: Oil futures add to yesterday's gains on the U.S. blockade of sanctioned tankers in and out of Venezuela.  The U.S. action against Venezuelan oil if continued "will likely cause production in the area to be shut-in with no destinations to ship out," Dennis Kissler of BOK Financial says in a note.  WTI remains technically bearish, he adds, with traders focusing on Ukraine-Russia peace efforts.
